title: Ember mirror
description: Your camera as a dark mirror. Move, and your outline sheds embers tinted with the colours of whatever moved. Each camera frame, a compute pass compares every cell of the picture with the last one and spawns particles where an edge moved. Without a camera, drifting smoke sets them off instead.
line: Move in front of the camera and your outline sheds embers.
hint: move to shed embers · without a camera, smoke shows instead
